_what: Second, BLIND hand-read of the same 51 spans as collateral-eval-hand-read.json (Reader A). Reader B was a separate agent on a different model, given only the 51 contexts (blind-read-material) and the detection definitions plus the codebook fixed in PREREG-2026-09-07-collateral-eval.md; it did not see Reader A's verdicts, the RESULTS file or any other file. tools/build_record.py computes the inter-rater agreement from the two files and the record prints it.
